title: Claude Now Builds Formulas and Charts in Google Workspace

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Users of Anthropic's AI can now produce data visualizations and spreadsheet functions through a deeper integration with Google's productivity suite. The updated assistant can generate formulas and build charts in Google Sheets, as well as create new slides that mirror the design of an existing presentation by using selected cells or text as context. a new setting also allows the tool to apply these edits automatically rather than requiring the user to approve changes one by one.

These capabilities extend a previous release that placed Claude in a sidebar within Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides, a feature currently in public beta for all paid plans. While the integration places the AI in direct competition with Google's own Gemini assistant, the partnership continues to benefit Google financially as Anthropic remains a major customer of Google Cloud infrastructure.

selectedTweets.bestBit: build spreadsheet formulas and charts, and even create new slides that match an existing presentation’s design
selectedTweets.text:
Claude can now do a lot more than read your Google Workspace files.

Inside Docs, Sheets, and Slides, it can make edits directly in the open file, use your selected text or cells as context, build spreadsheet formulas and charts, and even create new slides that match an existing presentation’s design. 

Users can approve edits one by one or let Claude apply them automatically, while separate connectors make it possible to start the same workflows from Claude itself.
